# Before the session {background-color="#E3120B" style="color:#F7F4ED"}

::: {style="margin-top: 1.0em; color:#F7F4ED"}
### Are sanctions a mechanism for regulating geopolitical risk — or a source of it?

## What to do, and how long it takes

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| **1** | Read the GSDB article, Hufbauer et al., Pape | 80 min |
| **2** | GSDB files arrived? TIES; `years.csv` | 15 min |
| **3** | Revise Sessions 07–09 for **Quiz 3** | — |
| **4** | Self-check | 15 min |

::: {.warn}
Teams: bring your **dashboard skeleton** — it is reviewed in the last 20 minutes of the practice round.
:::

## 1 · Read

| | |
|---|---|
| **Felbermayr et al. (2020)** | *European Economic Review* 129: 103561 · [doi](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.euroecorev.2020.103561) · **the target** |
| **Hufbauer et al. (2007)** | *Economic Sanctions Reconsidered*, 3rd ed., PIIE · ch. 1 and the success chapter |
| **Pape (1997)** | *International Security* 22(2): 90–136 · [doi](https://doi.org/10.1162/isec.22.2.90) |

Annotate: how **success** is coded · Pape's **critique** · how the **GSDB** is built · how sanctions hit **firms** that were not targets

## 2 · Get the data

::: {.step}
**GSDB Release 5** — the e-mailed files + codebook. **Not arrived? Tell the instructor before class.**
:::

::: {.step}
**TIES v4.0** — [sanctions.web.unc.edu](https://sanctions.web.unc.edu/) → case file + user manual
:::

::: {.step}
**`years.csv`** — header `Year`, rows 1945 … 2025
:::

::: {.warn}
GSDB licence: **no redistribution**. ZoneCours only — never Tableau Public with raw data.
:::

## 3 · Quiz 3 — opens the session

| Part | Points |
|---|---|
| **A · Concepts** — Sessions 07–09 | 4 |
| **B · One big work** | 3 |
| **C · Read an unseen chart** | 3 |

::: {.muted}
Twenty minutes, closed book. Specimen in `assessments/quizzes/`.
:::

## 4 · Self-check

1. **Comprehensive** vs **targeted** sanctions — one example each
2. Why might **threats** succeed more often than impositions?
3. What are **secondary sanctions** — and why do they reach a third-country firm?
4. Two reasons a firm leaves a market the law does not require it to leave

## Arrive with

::: {.check}
- Three works annotated
- GSDB, TIES, codebooks, `years.csv` in `data/raw/`
- Revised for Quiz 3
- Team dashboard skeleton
:::
